Display states seeded directly via rails runner (allowed app-context write) to avoid paid AI calls.

findings.title: Never-ran 'Generate criteria' button opens the shared 'Regenerate job criteria?' confirm modal ('re-extract' wording)
findings.detail: SPEC §8.3/§8.5 reuse RegenerateJobCriteriaConfirmModal (headerTitleText 'Regenerate job criteria?') for both the Generate and Regenerate actions. The section button label correctly differs (Generate vs Regenerate); only the shared modal title/copy says 'Regenerate'. Matches spec; noted for transparency.

findings.title: GET /ai_job_criteria wire payload uses snake_case top-level keys (extracted_at, zero_criteria_failure)
findings.detail: The raw HTTP response uses snake_case top-level keys; the frontend api.ts interceptor camelCases them to extractedAt/zeroCriteriaFailure (SPEC §5.3 'frontend camelCase after api.ts transform'). Matches the documented design; not a defect.
